Maya: Quick update on INC-872 postmortem actions — I pushed a draft owner grid in the doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/INC-872. Need to lock owners and due dates by EOD Friday.
Evan: I can take the "cache eviction" item, due Mon 2026-03-30. Will open PR for the rollback guard.
Rasheed: I'll own the canary routing change (needs infra config). ETA Wed 2026-03-25. Blocker: need static IP from cloud infra.
Sophie: @infra-team any update on the static IP? This blocks @Rasheed.
infra-bot: assign request received — ticket #INF-412 created and queued for provisioning.
Maya: Updated the action grid — owners: Evan (cache), Rasheed (canary), Sophie (postmortem doc + comms). Due dates: Evan 2026-03-30, Rasheed 2026-03-25, Sophie 2026-03-26.
Evan: Added PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1234 — needs review from @Sophie and @Maya. Small code change in `kv_cache.cpp`:
```
// guard to avoid double-eviction
if (cache.size() > max) evict_oldest();
```
Sophie: Will review tonight, ETA 10pm PT. Also suggest adding smoke test in CI to catch regression.
Rasheed: For the static IP dependency, can we do a short-lived NAT workaround? @Jenna from cloud?
Jenna: I can provision a floating IP for the canary by end of day. Will update INF-412 with IP and ETA.
Maya: Great. Two follow-ups: (1) Can everyone drop one-line status in the doc when work starts, (2) add PR/issue links in the grid. I'll run a final sweep Fri 4pm PT and confirm closure or extend.
Evan: Ack. I'll add PR and the test.
Sophie: Done — opened review and added CI job suggestion.
Rasheed: Starting infra changes now, will comment on INF-412 when IP is available.
Maya: Thanks — if anything slips, flag here and we'll adjust canary window. :thumbsup:
